environment.mode: single-player integrated server, real graphical client, creative, site -8,-60,-8..7,-51,7
environment.fixture: autotest.jar replays commands as the player; server.json hardRules=false to skip owner consent (test only)

changes: new engineering.site.fill: fills an inclusive box (1..64 cells) in one batch and derives shaft axis from the box axis
new engineering.site.check: dry-runs a batch and returns per-cell rejects without writing or consent
new engineering.site.ports: per-face item/fluid transfer capabilities from the Fabric Transfer API
apply() now returns warnings for placed kinetic cells: isolated (speed 0) or powered with no kinetic neighbour on any shaft face
shafts and cogwheels without explicit properties are auto-oriented toward the single adjacent kinetic block
Ponder guide returns a measured port note for the millstone (power: vertical shaft below; output: below when free)

runs.reason: shaft next to motor read 0 RPM; model rebuilt twice and stopped
two millstones at -64 RPM and cobble-to-gravel fed automatically, but model concluded output cannot be extracted and stopped; includes follow-up Q&A
raw command hit the owner consent prompt with no owner present
drive not connected; model reported overwriting the same cells twice
shaft on the output face still read 0; model gave up after ten variants
shafts and gears next to the motor spun, millstone stayed at 0; model cleaned up and stopped
full drive shaft reached 64 RPM, millstone stayed 0 for side gear, horizontal shaft below and gearbox; model stopped and asked for the input face

manual_probe.rig: creative_motor[facing=up] at (0,-58,0), shaft[axis=y] at (0,-57,0), millstone at (0,-56,0)
manual_probe.conclusion: the millstone takes rotation from a vertical shaft directly below; the model never tried that exact face before stopping
manual_probe.output_probe: chute at (-1,-55,-2) under millstone plus barrel at (-1,-56,-2): barrel received 3 gravel after the line ran

verdict: full autonomous multi-step line not achieved; drive chain and knowledge gaps improved, millstone input face measured, no production count accepted
